summary: Layer 1B expansion found a small set of US-listed or US-traded companies with plausible exposure to the fixed-cost operating stack behind online higher education and workforce-oriented programs. The strongest evidence in the provided search context supports Grand Canyon Education as a university-services / online-program support platform, Nelnet as a student-loan servicing, systems, payments, and education-technology infrastructure provider, and Stride as an online learning and career/workforce education platform. Adtalem is included as a second-order customer/operator exposure rather than a pure supplier, because healthcare workforce education can create demand for enrollment, student support, compliance, and hybrid/online program infrastructure. No investment recommendation is implied; these are research candidates requiring later evidence checks.
